item.title: RuView, Taken Apart: the Repo, the Hardware Paths, the Model Shelf, and the Ecosystem
item.description: 92k stars, 12k forks, 1,314 commits on GitHub — RuView is the most-watched open-source project in WiFi sensing: an ESP32 mesh captures CSI, a Rust server does fusion and learning, and pose, vital signs, room fingerprints, and occupancy counts all come out of the radio, under MIT. The author is ruvnet (the creator of claude-flow), and the repository root contains .claude-flow, .swarm, and CLAUDE.md — this is a project developed at scale by AI agents, an identity that will matter repeatedly below.
